supplementTo: result.json acceptance item 3 (recovered ecosystem conformance suite)
recorded: 2026-09-15 — attempted after the captain asked me to try the copy-and-build route the distribution lane proved, rather than settling for the first blocker. The task is terminal; this is evidence, not a status change.
previousBlocker: both suite attempts exit 1 because vendor/dsh-std/packages/core/lib/index.js is unbuilt (the checkout is read-only and ships no node_modules/lib)

whatWasTried.why: the suite resolves nine @dsh-std packages from DSH_STD_ROOT/packages/<name>/lib/index.js (conformance/tests/std-modules.js:16-19); the installed dsh-tui payload ships seven of them BUILT, and the checkout vendor tree is unbuilt
recipe: copy the vendored dsh-std SOURCE tree into .mpd/recon/std-root/vendor/dsh-std (19 packages, package.json + src)
copy the nine-minus-two BUILT lib/ trees from the installed payload (core, connection, manifest, command, storage, messages, presentation)
bun build from source -> lib/index.js for composition, session, lifecycle, workspace (all exit 0; @dsh-std/* left external, which are their only runtime imports besides builtins)
node_modules shim inside the tree so a bare @dsh-std/* import resolves to the same built files
build a spec copy whose vendor/dsh-std points at that tree, then run the lane with MPD_TUI_SPEC_ROOT=<copy>

pinnedCli.verdict: valid=true, decision=waiting_authorization, reasonCode=PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED, deniedPermissions=[the four session.*.intercept]
pinnedCli.meaning: the protocol own CLI now EXECUTES against our manifest — an independent second confirmation of the ruled admission state, previously not-run

pinnedSuite.stderr: error: pathspec 'vendor/dsh-std' did not match any file(s) known to git
pinnedSuite.newBlocker: conformance.mjs:91 runs `git submodule update --init --recursive vendor/dsh-std` — the full suite requires a git work tree AND a network fetch of the dsh-std submodule (https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-std.git). Our workspace copy has no .git, the checkout is read-only, and git write commands are forbidden by this task, so this lane stays NOT-RUN with this exact reason.

upgradedOutcome.requirements: all 7 pinned requirements (BASE-STD-001, TUI-PKG-001, TUI-PKG-002, TUI-PRIVATE-001, TUI-HOST-001, TUI-OBS-001, TUI-TRUST-001) evaluated with the pinned parser; statuses unchanged (pass)

netEffect: AC-14 moves from "both lanes not-run because a vendored dependency is unbuilt" to: the pinned CLI EXECUTED (exit 0) and produced its own verdict on our manifest, while the single remaining not-run lane is named with a sharper, verified blocker (git submodule init + network, forbidden here). No further upgrade is possible without a git write and network access.
